name: gb4pc-tools
description: The dot-and-tilde plugins this repository uses, each pinned to one dot-and-tilde commit.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: A multi-agent development cycle for GitHub issues, started with /orchestrate.

plugins.name: github-supplement
plugins.description: GitHub REST helpers on PATH, and hooks that fetch after sub-agents, read back GitHub writes, and keep worktree agents in their own scratchpad subdirectory.

plugins.name: agent-citizenship
plugins.description: Skills for editing code, opening a pull request, and writing issue descriptions and comments.
